pr_body:
This PR introduces `TestSocketUtils` as a replacement for the deprecated `SocketUtils`. It was borrowed from https://github.com/spring-projects/spring-framework/blob/main/spring-core/src/testFixtures/java/org/springframework/core/testfixture/net/TestSocketUtils.java.

Fixes #28210
pr_title: Introduce TestSocketUtils as a replacement for SocketUtils
pr_comment:
This has been merged into `5.3.x` and `main` in ee51dab1f348361f26c477ad64ab730ad7359d6e and revised in 698f8995f72239d11052e1319c6b2802a34ba3e8.

Thanks

review_comment: That's not essential, but thanks for the proposal.

I am expecting this to get balked at for a couple of reasons...
1. "controversial" inline mock maker 
2. mocking statics in general

On **1)**, I am not overly concerned w/ using the [inline mock maker](https://javadoc.io/doc/org.mockito/mockito-core/latest/org/mockito/Mockito.html#39) as I do not see any of the scenarios in `spring-test` that is has known issues with. Albeit, it might be considered a bit intrusive for only adding a single test case. 

On **2)**, I always have mixed feelings on mocking statics.

I figured I would throw this out here and see what the team suggests.

Indeed, we don't have any plans to mock statics within Framework.

I have therefore revised the approach in a local commit that I will push as a follow up to merging your PR.
